changelog:
Version 1.1.0 brings Bilibili support, better subtitle extraction, and detailed language guidelines:

- Added support for Bilibili videos: subtitle extraction and note generation now work for both YouTube and BiliBili URLs.
- Enhanced YouTube subtitle script: supports browser cookie authentication for age-restricted/login-required videos, with clear usage instructions.
- Improved fallback strategies for subtitle formats (VTT/SRT) and built-in heuristics for reliable extraction.
- Updated documentation with detailed workflow for Chinese/English videos and clarified requirements for UI language matching the user's request.
- No breaking changes to existing YouTube functionality; base workflow remains the same.
